import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

pull_path = Path('results/training/kaggle_compile_ablation.json')
pull = json.loads(pull_path.read_text())
assert pull['status'] == 'outputs_retrieved'
source = Path('runs/kaggle_compile_ablation_output')
out = Path('results/kaggle/compiler-ablation-v1')
shutil.copytree(source, out, dirs_exist_ok=True)
pair = json.loads((out / 'pair_runtime.json').read_text())
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain the focused compiler ablation on fixed development states only'}, pair['model_revision']),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'download_receipt': str(pull_path), 'pair_runtime': pair,
          'files_sha256': {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}, 'stages': {},
          'interpretation': 'Descriptive compiler ablation, not a new policy test or training trial. Baseline and case quotes, timing and memory retained even on failure.'}
for stage in ('sft', 'grpo'):
    path = out / stage / 'inference_profile.json'
    if not path.exists():
        record['stages'][stage] = {'status': 'profile_not_saved', 'runtime_file': str(out / stage / 'runtime.json')}
        continue
    p = json.loads(path.read_text())
    prior = json.loads(Path(f'results/kaggle/inference-profile-v1/{stage}/inference_profile.json').read_text())
    assert p['prompts_sha256'] == prior['prompts_sha256'] and p['states'] == prior['states']
    assert p['compiler_environment'] == {'UNSLOTH_COMPILE_DISABLE': '1'}
    baseline = p['initial_serial_baseline_including_warmup']['quotes']
    compiled_baseline = prior['initial_serial_baseline_including_warmup']['quotes']
    summary = {'status': p['status'], 'initial_serial_changes_vs_compiled': [i for i, (a,b) in enumerate(zip(baseline, compiled_baseline)) if a != b], 'batch_sizes': {}}
    for size in (1, 4):
        cases = [m for m in p['measurements'] if m['batch_size'] == size]
        if cases:
            summary['batch_sizes'][size] = {'measurements': len(cases), 'median_wall_seconds': median(m['wall_seconds'] for m in cases),
                                            'peak_allocated_bytes': max(m['peak_allocated_bytes'] for m in cases),
                                            'quote_mismatches_vs_own_serial': [m['quote_mismatch_indices'] for m in cases],
                                            'quote_mismatches_vs_compiled_serial': [[i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(m['quotes'], compiled_baseline)) if a != b] for m in cases]}
    record['stages'][stage] = summary
Path('results/training/kaggle_compile_ablation_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
path = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger = json.loads(path.read_text())
for session in ledger['sessions']:
    if session['kernel'] == pull['metadata']['id'] and session['version'] == 1:
        session.update(status='completed_outputs_retrieved' if pair['exit_codes'] == [0,0] else 'partial_outputs_retrieved',
                       script_wall_seconds=pair['wall_seconds'], hours=pair['wall_seconds']/3600,
                       hours_basis='Downloaded script runtime; exact allocation billing boundaries unavailable.',
                       observed_complete_at=pull['polls'][-1]['at'], result_file=str(out / 'pair_runtime.json'))
path.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'runtime_seconds': pair['wall_seconds'], 'exit_codes': pair['exit_codes'], 'stages': record['stages']}, indent=2))
